paper_metadata.title: High temperature brittle intergranular cracking in high strength nickel alloys undoped and doped with S, Zr, and/or B—II. Solute segregation analysis

evidence.section: 4.1 Mechanisms of local S enrichment and high temperature brittle intergranular cracking
evidence.quote: The S fluxes from crack surfaces and sulfides to the crack tip facilitate locally intergranular decohesion [Fig. 17(c)].

The alloys with low S, and high S and B showed more strongly S segregation on high temperature fracture surfaces, which was much greater compared with at grain boundaries, than with high S, and high S and Zr.

mechanisms.name: S diffusion at grain boundaries and on crack surfaces

evidence.quote: it was shown that the HT brittle intergranular cracking is controlled by S diffusion at grain boundaries and on crack surfaces.
it has been shown [1] that the activation energies relevant to HT brittle cracking are highly correlated with for S diffusion at grain boundaries and on crack surfaces.

evidence.section: 4.1 Mechanisms of local S enrichment and high temperature brittle intergranular cracking
evidence.quote: It must also be emphasized that the strong tendency of S segregation on free surfaces becomes an important factor for HT brittle cracking because a crack as free surfaces becomes a supplying source of embrittling S.
